name: validate_spec
description: Validates a spec against the schema in knowledge/spec-schema.md: required frontmatter fields, required sections in order, internal SPEC ID links resolve, Figma URLs are well-formed, design system component names match knowledge/design-system-index.md exactly. Use before any status transition, before saving an in-review spec, and whenever the user asks 'is this spec ready'. Do NOT use as a general read — use Read for that. Returns a structured list of violations; does not modify the file.

strict.description: If true, treat warnings as errors. Use when validating before transition to in-review or approved.
